title: Fix the learning — Learning Repair
description: Un-teach a bad value: open Learning Repair, which lists every sender-and-type ScanFinder has learned from; open one, see the documents behind its reading, spot the one flagged 'Data looks off', and Send back to Review (non-destructive — it returns to the Review list to fix and confirm). Settings -> Learning Repair. REWRITTEN for the current UI: the old #rp-doctype select + #rp-load 'Open' button are gone; the panel is now a scope list (#rp-scope-search + .rp-scope-row[data-sup][data-slug] + filter pills). Clicking a scope row opens the detail, which still has #rp-doclist / .rp-row / #rp-suspects-strip / #rp-send. Needs a warm dataset with a poisoned learned value: the demo has 8 confirmed invoices (3 Copperfield, 5 Ironbridge), with one Copperfield invoice_number garbled to 'lNV-295g7' so the suspect detector (B1 shape-miss) flags it.

steps.narration: When ScanFinder learns a wrong value from a document, it can keep reading that sender wrong. Learning Repair lets you find the culprit and put it right.
steps.caption: Fix what it learned wrong

steps.narration: Open Settings from the side bar.
steps.caption: 1. Open Settings

steps.narration: Nothing here is destructive. This lists every sender and type ScanFinder has learned from, and the filters up top jump straight to anything worth a look.
steps.caption: 3. Everything it has learned

steps.narration: Open the one you want to check.
steps.caption: 4. Open a sender's learning

steps.narration: Straight away, ScanFinder points out the ones worth a look — here, a document whose value reads oddly against the rest.
steps.caption: It flags the odd one

steps.narration: Below are all the documents teaching this type's reading. If one was filed with a bad value, that's what's teaching the mistake.
steps.caption: The documents it learned from

steps.narration: Open the flagged one, and there's the odd value — and exactly why it stands out.
steps.caption: 5. Open the flagged document

steps.narration: Found the bad one? Send back to Review. It doesn't delete anything — it just lands back in your Review list, ready to fix and confirm again.
steps.caption: 6. Send back to Review

steps.narration: Fix it once, confirm it right, and that sender reads correctly from then on.
steps.caption: One fix, right from then on
